items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 39:1
items.html: The records of the four kings of HGT descended first into the discernment of NHYM of Atzilut, and afterward clothed in the new vessels of HGT that were made from the posteriors of AVI of Nekudim. And the record of the four kings NHYM rose first to the new vessels of HGT, and afterward descended from there, and clothed in the new vessels of NH that were made from the posteriors of Yeshsut. (p. 539, Sub Header, “The Light of Da'at.” And in the Inner Observation, p. 559, Item 32)
